questions.prompt: Calculate \(\mathcal L\{t^{1}\}(s)\) from the defining integral.
questions.answer:
We need to complete the requested calculation or proof.
Method: Apply the stated mathematical method and simplify each step.
Repeated integration by parts gives
\[\int_0^\infty e^{-st}t^{1}dt=\frac{1!}{s^{2}},\qquad s>0.\]
Final answer: \(\mathcal L\{t^{1}\}=1/s^{2}\), \(s>0\).
